title: TEX: Test-Time Scaling Testing Agents via Execution-based Cross-Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-case generation is critical but remains challenging for language models. Existing test-time scaling methods either isolate candidates or aggregate traces, which do not scale to long-horizon tasks. We present TEX, a collaborative test-time scaling framework based on execution-driven cross-validation. TEX parallelizes agents to generate tests and patches, cross-executing each test against every patch to form a $K \times K$ feedback matrix. Agents use their matrix slices for refinement, enabling objective validation without verbose trace sharing. On SWT-Bench Verified, TEX achieves 86.4%, establishing a new state-of-the-art and improving +9.0% over single-agent baselines. Moreover, even random selection from TEX outputs (84.4%) surpasses the previous SOTA (84.0%), showing collaborative execution feedback improves solution quality, not just best-case samples. Our results highlight execution-grounded feedback as an effective scaling mech

translated_title: TEX：通过基于执行的交叉验证实现测试时代理的测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试用例生成对语言模型至关重要，但仍然具有挑战性。现有的测试时扩展方法要么孤立地处理候选方案，要么聚合执行轨迹，这些方法无法扩展到长时程任务。我们提出了TEX，一个基于执行驱动交叉验证的协作式测试时扩展框架。TEX并行化多个代理来生成测试和补丁，将每个测试与每个补丁交叉执行，形成一个K×K的反馈矩阵。各代理利用自己的矩阵切片进行改进，无需冗长的轨迹共享即可实现客观验证。在SWT-Bench Verified基准上，TEX达到了86.4%的准确率，创下新的最先进水平，比单代理基线提升了9.0%。此外，即使从TEX输出中随机选择（84.4%）也超越了之前的SOTA（84.0%），表明协作式执行反馈提升的是解决方案的整体质量，而不仅仅是最佳样本。我们的研究结果突出了基于执行的反馈作为一种有效的扩展机制。
tldr: TEX提出了一种基于执行驱动交叉验证的协作式测试时扩展框架，通过并行代理生成测试和补丁并交叉执行形成K×K反馈矩阵实现客观验证，在SWT-Bench Verified上以86.4%的成绩创下新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: TEX proposes a collaborative test-time scaling framework via execution-driven cross-validation, where parallel agents generate tests and patches cross-executed into a K×K feedback matrix for objective validation, achieving a new state-of-the-art of 86.4% on SWT-Bench Verified.
